name: page-trust
description: Trust-and-recognition section of the 2026 company pages (Our Company, Figma 7460:104417): intro copy (eyebrow, heading, paragraphs) beside an icon aside (heading, short copy), then a row of award cards (badge image, title, category lines, linked or plain), then an outline and a gradient button and an arrow link, centred.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

body.description: Intro copy. Blank line = new paragraph; [label](url) links, **bold**.

awards.description: Award cards (four to a row on desktop). Each: image (badge URL), image_alt, width and height (drawn 90px tall), title (h3), items [{ label, url }] (category lines; url optional).

secondary_label.description: Outline button text. Renders only with secondary_url.

cta_label.description: Gradient button text. Renders only with cta_url.

link_label.description: Arrow link under the buttons. Renders only with link_url.
